title: Workflow builder
subtitle: States, transitions, guards and SLA · workflow_admin only · versioned.

banner.title: Only approved changes.
banner.body: Transitions are checked against the published version only — there is no status bypass. Changes go from draft to publish, and the approver must be a different person, enforced by a database rule. Published versions cannot be changed. Risk and SLA values live in the engine settings and cannot be edited here.

sla.title: SLA model
sla.loadError: The SLA calendars could not be loaded. Nothing was changed.
sla.none: No SLA calendar is set up. Deadlines, working days and escalation are governed inputs — until one is approved, timers stay pending and no deadline is shown.
sla.note: Deadlines are computed only from an approved working calendar. There is no scheduler: a breach is never triggered on its own, and no default duration is assumed.
